tagline: Firewalls, routers aur servers apne logs ek jagah kaise bhejte hain.
description: Syslog log messages ka common format aur transport hai. Device ek line likhta hai jisme priority, timestamp, uska naam aur message hota hai, aur use central log server ko bhejta hai. Classic transport UDP port 514 hai; zaroori logs TLS par port 6514 se jaate hain, framed taaki receiver ko pata chale ki har message kahan khatam hota hai.
legend: Kho gaye logs ya blocked traffic

normal.name: Firewall ek blocked connection log karta hai
normal.summary: Firewall UDP 514 par ek log line bhejta hai, phir octet counting ke saath TLS 6514 par isi tarah ke logs.

steps.title: Log karne laayak kuch hua
steps.desc: Ek scanner port 23 par dastak deta hai
steps.detail: Internet par ek machine office par Telnet connection (port 23) kholne ki koshish karti hai. Firewall ka rule 12 use block kar deta hai. Firewall khud lambi history nahi rakhta, isliye woh event ko syslog line mein badal kar central log server ko bhejta hai.

steps.title: UDP 514 par syslog
steps.detail: Poori log line ek hi UDP datagram mein port 514 par jaati hai. Woh <134> se shuru hoti hai: facility local0 (16) × 8 + severity informational (6). Phir version, precise UTC timestamp, host name, program (filterlog), uska process ID, ek message ID, square brackets mein structured data aur aakhir mein insaanon ke liye text aata hai.

quiz.q: Ek message <132> se shuru hota hai. Uski facility local0 (16) hai. Severity kya hai?
quiz.why: PRI = facility × 8 + severity. 16 × 8 = 128, aur 132 − 128 = 4, jo warning hai.

steps.title: TLS connection kholo
steps.detail: Security logs clear text mein nahi jaane chahiye aur na hi kho jaane chahiye, isliye firewall TLS (RFC 5425) se bhi bhejne ke liye set hai. Woh port 6514 par TCP kholta hai aur TLS 1.3 handshake chalata hai. Log server certificate se apni identity prove karta hai; kai setups firewall se client certificate bhi maangte hain taaki fake devices logs inject na kar saken.

steps.title: Octet-counted frames
steps.detail: TCP ek stream hai jisme message boundaries nahi hoti, isliye RFC 5425 har message ke aage length rakhta hai: “186 <134>1 2026-11-19T10:1…”. Receiver space tak digits padhta hai, phir bilkul utne bytes. TLS ke andar poora frame encrypted hota hai; wire par sirf 207-byte Application Data record dikhta hai.
facts: TCP mein message edges nahi hote

quiz.q: Har message ko text file ki tarah newline se khatam kyun nahi karte?
options: TLS mein newlines allowed nahi hain
Message mein khud newline ho sakti hai, jo use galat tarah se tod degi
quiz.why: Stack traces aur multi-line messages aam hain. Length prefix receiver ko bilkul batata hai ki har message kahan khatam hota hai, andar kuch bhi ho.

steps.title: Aur logs, wahi connection
steps.desc: Kai frames ek segment share kar sakte hain
steps.detail: Connection khula rehta hai. Kuch seconds baad ek failed SSH login (<132>, warning) aur ek config change (<133>, notice) aate hain; yahan dono do TLS records ki tarah ek hi TCP segment mein jaate hain. TCP ke acknowledgements firewall ko batate hain ki bytes server tak pahunch gaye, aur TLS unhe raaste mein private aur untampered rakhta hai.

outro.title: Logs collect ho gaye
outro.text: Har event ek RFC 5424 line ban gaya: priority, timestamp, host, app, IDs, structured data aur text. UDP 514 par yeh tez aur simple tha; TLS 6514 par yeh encrypted tha, TCP se acknowledged, aur length ke saath framed taaki messages kabhi aapas mein na milein.

burst.name: Burst mein logs kho gaye (UDP)
burst.summary: Port scan ke dauran firewall har second sau-do-sau UDP logs bhejta hai aur kuch gayab ho jaate hain; TCP par RELP isse theek karta hai.

steps.title: Scan shuru hota hai
steps.detail: Ek scanner ek saath kai ports par sweep karta hai. Har blocked attempt ek syslog message ban jaata hai, isliye firewall achanak log server ko har second sau-do-sau UDP datagrams bhejta hai.

steps.title: Kuch datagrams gayab
steps.detail: Log server ka receive buffer program ke padhne se tez bhar jaata hai, aur kernel naye datagrams drop kar deta hai. Kisi ko pata nahi chalta: UDP mein ACKs nahi hote aur syslog messages mein sequence numbers nahi hote, isliye firewall ko kabhi pata nahi chalta ki kuch lines missing hain. Wahi lines ho sakti hain jinki investigator ko zaroorat ho.

quiz.q: Firewall ko kaise pata chalta hai ki teen messages kho gaye?
options: Pata nahi chalta; UDP koi feedback nahi deta
Har ek ke liye ICMP error
quiz.why: UDP fire-and-forget hai. Receiver ka full socket buffer datagrams chupchaap drop kar deta hai, aur sender ko pata chalne ka koi tareeka nahi.

steps.title: Fix: acknowledged transport
steps.desc: RELP: har message ka jawab milta hai
steps.detail: Plain TCP ya TLS network loss pehle hi rok deta hai, lekin agar server crash ho jaye to buffers mein baitha data phir bhi gayab ho sakta hai. RELP (Reliable Event Logging Protocol, rsyslog use karta hai) application-level reply jodta hai: har frame ek transaction number carry karta hai, aur server us number ke liye “rsp 200 OK” tabhi bolta hai jab use message mil jaaye. Unconfirmed messages reconnect ke baad dobara bheje jaate hain.
facts: TXNR SP CMD SP LEN SP DATA LF

quiz.q: Firewall ne frame 7 bheja lekin koi rsp aane se pehle TCP connection toot gaya. Message 7 ka kya hota hai?
options: Hamesha ke liye kho jaata hai
Firewall reconnect ke baad use dobara bhejta hai
TCP khud naye connection par use dobara bhejta hai
Server naam leke use maangta hai
quiz.why: RELP har unconfirmed message rakhta hai aur agle session par replay karta hai. Akela TCP yeh nahi kar sakta kyunki uske buffers connection ke saath mar jaate hain.

outro.title: Kaam ke hisaab se transport chuno
outro.text: UDP syslog baatuni, low-value logs ke liye theek hai, lekin load mein messages chupchaap drop kar deta hai. Security aur audit logs ke liye TCP ya TLS (6514) use karo, aur RELP tab jab har message ka receiver se confirm hona zaroori ho.

cheatsheet.title: Ports and framing
items: TXNR CMD LEN DATA LF, rsp 200 OK
<PRI>1 TIME HOST APP PROCID MSGID [SD] MSG
